terms.grammar: noun, first declension; diminutive of anus
evidence: Ter. Ph. 1.2.48: extrā ūnam aniculam (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Div. 2.15: haec nē aniculae quidem exīstimant (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Fond or slighting by turns, as diminutives are.

sources: The grouped card gave no source for this word.
